class.name: TrackCurve
class.description: From [member p1] to [member p2], its handles [member c1] and [member c2] relative to the ends, the rails rolled [member roll1] at [member p1] and [member roll2] at [member p2]; a [member radius] other than 0 makes it an arc. Every change is announced ([signal Resource.changed]).

method.name: translated
method.description: A copy of the curve moved by [param offset] - its handles are relative to its ends.

members.member: The handle at the start, relative to [member p1].
The handle at the end, relative to [member p2].
The arc's radius [m]; 0 for a curve by its handles.
The rails' roll at the start [rad].
The rails' roll at the end [rad].
